Name: SweptWing
Description: Closed thin tapered/swept/twisted wing, sharp facets; intentionally dense planar triangle fans; balanced planar control.

Name: ToothedWheel
Description: Closed concave 12-tooth wheel with a central through-hole, sharp creases; dense planar fans; balanced planar control.

Name: FacetedArch
Description: Closed U-shaped curved beam with planar front/back panels and inner/outer facets; dense planar fans; balanced planar control.

Name: TrefoilKnot
Description: Smooth closed self-occluding knot tube; integer helical UV shear of two tube samples per centerline ring; unsheared control.

Name: SpiralRamp
Description: Open two-turn helicoid with negative Gaussian curvature and sheared UV lattice; control only selects shorter cell diagonals.
